title: Student Training in Engineering Program (STEP)
location: Mountain View, NYC, Seattle, Austin, Chicago
description: A 12-week paid software engineering internship for first- and second-year undergraduates, working in pairs on a real Google codebase project with a mentor plus technical training.
eligibility: US postings require work authorization, which F-1 students normally satisfy with CPT. Google is a large, consistent H-1B filer but makes no blanket sponsorship promise — read each posting.

title: University Internship (SWE, PM, Data, Security)
location: Redmond WA, Atlanta GA, other US sites
description: Microsoft's flagship 12-week summer internship across software engineering, program management, data science, hardware and security, with competitive pay and relocation support.
eligibility: Microsoft's internship FAQ states plainly that it provides visa sponsorship, and it is consistently a top-five H-1B sponsor. F-1 interns still use CPT for the internship itself.

title: Explore Microsoft Program
description: A 12-week rotational summer internship built for first- and second-year students that rotates through both software engineering and program management rather than specialising.
eligibility: Requires an intro CS course and one semester of calculus. Microsoft states it provides visa sponsorship and has a strong H-1B record; the internship itself runs on CPT.

title: Software Development Engineer Intern
description: A 12-week paid internship where interns own a real project end to end across distributed systems, ML, or AWS services, with strong full-time conversion.
eligibility: Amazon is the single largest H-1B sponsor in the US by approved petitions, though individual postings vary. The internship itself is done on CPT.

title: Meta Internships (Engineering, Data, Design)
location: Menlo Park CA, Seattle WA, NYC
description: Paid summer internships across software engineering, data engineering, product design, analytics and business, with mentorship, housing assistance, and a path to full-time conversion.
eligibility: Meta is a top-five US H-1B sponsor by volume and routinely converts international interns, but publishes no blanket guarantee — confirm per requisition. Interns work on CPT.

title: NVIDIA Internship and Ignite Program
location: Santa Clara CA, Austin TX, Durham NC
description: Year-round paid internships of at least 12 weeks in GPU architecture, systems software, deep learning and graphics, plus Ignite, a summer pre-internship for freshmen and sophomores.
eligibility: NVIDIA has a large and growing H-1B approval record, but sponsorship is decided per role and is not stated on the program page. Interns use CPT.

title: Qualcomm Internship and Early-in-Career Program
location: San Diego CA, Santa Clara CA, Boulder CO, Austin TX
description: Paid summer internships in wireless systems, chip design, embedded software, machine learning and hardware verification, feeding Qualcomm's entry-level engineering pipeline.
eligibility: One of the largest per-capita H-1B sponsors among US semiconductor firms, but no sponsorship statement appears on the program hub — confirm on the specific requisition.

title: Micron University Recruiting Internship
location: Boise ID, Manassas VA, Clay NY, Folsom CA
description: Paid summer internships of at least 12 weeks in process engineering, semiconductor manufacturing, hardware design and data science, with housing and relocation support.
eligibility: A consistent H-1B sponsor for engineering roles tied to its US fab expansion, though sponsorship is not stated on the recruiting page. Applications open in August; most roles fill by end of January.

title: Americas Summer Analyst Program
location: New York, Dallas, Salt Lake City
description: A nine to ten week summer internship across investment banking, engineering, asset management, sales and trading, with a direct pipeline to the full-time New Analyst Program.
eligibility: For third or penultimate-year students. Goldman files H-1B petitions annually but publishes no sponsorship policy, and decisions are selective by division.

title: Quantitative Researcher / AI Research Intern
description: A summer internship in quantitative and AI research at a systematic investment firm, working on real signal research and modeling problems alongside full-time researchers.
eligibility: An established H-1B filing record for quantitative roles and many international PhD/MS hires, but no public sponsorship policy — confirm with the recruiter before investing in the process.

title: D. E. Shaw Group Summer Internship
description: A 10-12 week summer internship across quantitative strategies, software development, systems engineering and trading, with housing, technology and travel provided.
eligibility: Reviewed on a rolling basis and typically filled early in Q1, so apply by the end of the prior year. The firm sponsors H-1B for some hires but publishes no statement — ask directly.

title: IMC Trading Summer Internship
description: A 10-week internship in quantitative trading, research, software development or hardware engineering, structured as classroom training then live project work on trading systems.
eligibility: Aimed at penultimate-year undergraduates in analytical fields, no finance background required. IMC sponsors visas in some offices but US postings carry no statement — verify per role.

title: Software Engineer Intern (Summer 2027)
description: A paid summer software engineering internship at a global market maker, building low-latency trading systems alongside traders and researchers.
eligibility: One of the few firms that says it in writing: the posting states Optiver is supportive of US immigration sponsorship for this role. Open to juniors and above.

title: Genentech Summer Internship
location: South San Francisco / Vacaville / Oceanside CA, Hillsboro OR
description: Paid 10-12 week internships across research biology, bioinformatics, process development, manufacturing and commercial functions, with relocation or housing stipends.
eligibility: States it accepts international students, though visa sponsorship support varies by position and department, and you must be work-authorized for the internship itself.

title: Future Talent Program Internships
location: Rahway NJ / West Point PA / Boston MA / Durham NC
description: Paid 10-12 week summer internships and co-ops across research, manufacturing, data science and commercial functions, typically posted in early September.
eligibility: Sponsorship is not offered for the internship itself — you use CPT/OPT via your DSO. Full-time post-graduate roles may carry sponsorship; check each posting's visa section.

title: Eli Lilly Summer Internship
description: A 10-12 week paid internship across drug discovery, clinical development, data and analytics, engineering and manufacturing sciences, and technology.
eligibility: Lilly sponsors H-1B for scientific and technical roles, but the internship pages do not address work authorization — confirm for the specific function before relying on it.

title: Deloitte US Summer Internship
location: New York, Chicago, Dallas, San Francisco
description: Paid summer internships across consulting, audit and assurance, tax and risk, including the national intern conference at Deloitte University.
eligibility: Among the largest US H-1B filers overall, but sponsorship at Big Four firms is selective by service line and many client-facing postings expect existing authorization. Confirm before the offer stage.

title: EY Summer and Winter Internships
description: Paid summer and winter internships across assurance, tax, consulting and technology, working on live client engagements such as internal control reviews and automation builds.
eligibility: EY files H-1B at high volume, but sponsorship varies significantly by service line and office and is not addressed on the student pages — treat as uncertain until a recruiter confirms.

title: Summer Business Analyst
description: An 8-10 week summer consulting internship placing undergraduates on real client engagement teams, with a strong conversion path into the full-time Business Analyst role.
eligibility: An established practice of sponsoring work visas for consultants hired from US campuses, but nothing is stated publicly and it varies by office and year — raise it early with recruiting.

title: MIT Summer Research Program (MSRP)
description: A nine-week paid summer research program placing undergraduates in MIT labs across science, engineering and computing, with stipend, housing, travel and grad-school preparation.
eligibility: Explicitly open to an international student with appropriate visa and work authorizations who is enrolled full-time at a US institution. Students at universities outside the US are not eligible.

title: BSG-MSRP-Bio Summer Research
description: The biology-specific MSRP track, placing undergraduates in MIT Biology labs for a funded ten-week summer research project starting in June.
eligibility: States verbatim that international students on F-1 visas with outstanding academic records who meet all criteria are eligible. One of the few programs naming F-1 directly.

title: Summer Undergraduate Research Fellowship (SURF)
location: Rochester MN / Jacksonville FL / Scottsdale AZ
description: A 10-week paid biomedical research fellowship taking about 180 undergraduates a year across three Mayo campuses, spanning neuroscience, immunology and biomedical engineering.
eligibility: One of the clearest yes answers available: international students at US colleges are eligible, and accepted students submit OPT or CPT documentation. Mayo is also cap-exempt for later H-1B sponsorship.

title: Undergraduate Research Program (URP)
description: A nine-week summer fellowship with a $7,000 stipend plus free room and board, embedding sophomores and juniors in labs working on genetics, neuroscience and cancer biology.
eligibility: Students of any nationality are eligible, but foreign students must be enrolled full-time at a US college on a student visa. The NSF-funded REU slots are restricted to citizens — apply to the non-restricted fellowships.

title: Summer Undergraduate Research Program (SURP)
description: Nine-week cancer research internship paying $7,304 plus housing and a travel stipend, with full participation required across the whole period.
eligibility: The main page says US citizen or permanent resident, but the FAQ explicitly overrides this: F-1 holders WITH CPT authorization are eligible. Read the FAQ, not the summary.

title: Summer Undergraduate Research (Cech Fellows)
description: A nine-week residential program placing undergraduates in unusually small Janelia labs of two to six people, working on neuroscience, imaging and computational biology.
eligibility: HHMI is a cap-exempt nonprofit, which helps for later sponsorship. We could not verify Janelia's international-student policy directly — email the program before applying.

title: Newborn Medicine Summer Student Research Program
description: Eight-week paid research program in the Division of Newborn Medicine, run with the Harvard Program in Neonatology at Boston Children's and Beth Israel Deaconess.
eligibility: States verbatim that an applicant in the US on an F-1 student visa would be eligible to apply. No visa sponsorship offered — you supply your own CPT/OPT authorization.

title: Summer Student Fellowship
description: A paid summer research fellowship at the largest independent oceanographic institution in the US, pairing rising seniors with a scientist mentor, including a research cruise.
eligibility: International students may apply, but WHOI withholds 14% US federal income tax from international fellows' stipends and housing value. You must not graduate before the fellowship starts.

title: Brookings Institution Internship
description: A paid research internship placing about 150 students a year across Brookings' research programs in economics, foreign policy, governance and metropolitan policy.
eligibility: Brookings publishes no visa policy, so plan to use CPT — but as a 501(c)(3) nonprofit research organization it is the type of employer that can file cap-exempt H-1B petitions year-round.

title: Google Summer of Code Contributor
description: A 12+ week stipend-funded program pairing new contributors with a mentor at an open source organization to ship a real project, entirely online with no geographic restriction.
eligibility: Open worldwide with no citizenship bar. Important: F-1 students physically in the US should check with their DSO first — a stipend for work performed in the US can be treated as employment requiring CPT or OPT.

title: Outreachy Open Source Internship
description: A three-month fully remote paid internship with a $7,000 stipend, working with a mentor on open source programming, design, documentation, data science or marketing.
eligibility: Open worldwide to applicants facing under-representation in tech where they live, with no citizenship requirement. F-1 students in the US should confirm with their DSO whether CPT is needed for the stipend.

title: MLH Fellowship
description: A 12-week fully remote internship alternative with an educational stipend, where fellows work in small pods on real open source projects across software and site-reliability tracks.
eligibility: Fully remote and open globally, a common fallback when US postings demand existing work authorization. Pays an educational stipend rather than wages; F-1 students in the US should confirm the arrangement with their DSO.

title: Americas New Analyst Program
location: New York, Dallas, Salt Lake City
description: Goldman's full-time entry point for new graduates across 16+ divisions from investment banking and engineering to risk and asset management, with structured onboarding.
eligibility: For students graduating between December 2026 and July 2027. Goldman files H-1B annually but does not publish a sponsorship commitment, and decisions vary by division.

title: Graduate Software Engineer (2027 start)
description: A full-time new-graduate software engineering role at a global market maker, with structured onboarding covering trading systems, low-latency C++ and market microstructure.
eligibility: Optiver's US postings state in writing that it is supportive of US immigration sponsorship for this role — rare among quant trading firms, and a genuinely strong H-1B target.

title: Recent Graduate Roles and Aspire Experience
location: Redmond WA, Atlanta GA, other US sites
description: Full-time entry-level roles for students graduating within 12 months, wrapped in the Aspire Experience — a year-plus structured learning, mentorship and cohort programme.
eligibility: Microsoft states in its student FAQ that it provides visa sponsorship and is consistently a top-five US H-1B sponsor, though each requisition governs. You must graduate within 12 months of the hire date.

title: Data Science and Applied Research Associate
location: McLean VA, Richmond VA, New York NY, Plano TX
description: Capital One's full-time new-graduate tracks in data science and applied research, with project assignments in machine learning, modeling and applied AI.
eligibility: These tracks state that associates are eligible for sponsorship upon joining full-time. Note the contrast with the Technology Development Program, whose postings say it will not sponsor.

title: Software Development Engineer I (New Grad)
location: Seattle WA, Arlington VA, NYC, Austin TX
description: Amazon's full-time entry-level engineering role, placing new graduates on teams across AWS, retail, devices and advertising through Amazon University Talent Acquisition.
eligibility: The largest US H-1B sponsor by approved petitions, filing at high volume for entry-level SDE roles, which materially improves lottery odds — though selection still depends on the annual cap.
